svg.title: Path-local majority decoder: every logical gate
svg.desc: Read panels A, B and C in order. Four syndrome wires become prefix bits, seventeen exact CCX blocks compute the majority flag, nine CX gates XOR the decoded word into arbitrary targets, and reversed CCX and prefix gates restore the three scratch wires and original syndrome. All 34 CCX and 15 CX glyphs are visible. Each CCX represents the full fifteen-primitive phase-exact lowering in the linked saved source, totaling 525 primitives. The full 31-wire program is generation-only and is not shown.
svg.text: 12 wires · arbitrary clause targets · clean scratch at the component boundaries
Read A → B → C. Wire indices continue unchanged between panels.

g.text: B XOR the decoded word into arbitrary targets
C Erase the flag and restore the syndrome

svg.text: M(r) = r₂r₃r₄ ⊕ r₂r₃r₅ ⊕ r₂r₄r₅ ⊕ r₃r₄r₅ ⊕ r₂r₃r₄r₅ (threshold ≥ 3)
Every CCX uses H=2, CX=6, T=4, T†=3: 34 × 15 + 15 = 525 primitives.
Clean-scratch action: |s,t,000⟩ → |s,t ⊕ d(s),000⟩. No preparation, reset or readout is in this component.
Full phase-exact words and source indices are retained in component.qasm and component.ndjson.
